key_insight: Cqlib unifies quantum program development, simulation, compilation, and hardware execution around a shared circuit model and a high-performance Rust core.
engineering_relevance: Python and C interfaces, reusable algorithm libraries, and QCIS-compatible backend integration support end-to-end quantum computing workflows.
method: Use consistent circuit semantics across processing, simulation, optimization, and compilation.
Connect OpenQASM and QCIS representations to device backends and domain-specific application libraries.
Integrate source-grounded Skills and MCP tools for agent-assisted generation, execution, and workflow refinement.
evidence_signal: Benchpress parameterized compilation tasks and related tests indicate functional coverage, compilation correctness, and execution efficiency within the evaluated scope; the abstract reports no numerical results.
watch_item: Performance and portability beyond the evaluated tasks and QCIS-compatible hardware remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Cqlib: A High-Performance Software Stack for Quantum Computing
